scope: Evidence-backed case analyses. Candidate findings were usually repaired or rolled back; they are not presented as errors in every final output. Possible auditor over-rejection is distinguished from known-answer false positives.

cases.title: Unsupported causal link
cases.analysis: A connective added for fluency can introduce a causal claim absent from the source.
cases.nextStep: Require each added causal relation to be supported by a source span; otherwise preserve the two statements without a causal connector.

observedEvent.originalQuote: A local inventory may also contain outdated boundaries.
observedEvent.revisedQuote: A local inventory might contain outdated boundaries, as no field measurements have been collected for this proposal [S1].
observedEvent.problem: Adds an unsupported causal connection: the absence of field measurements for this proposal does not explain whether the inventory boundaries are outdated.
observedEvent.evidenceType: model audit finding with exact supplied quotations; assess its validity before treating it as a confirmed error

cases.title: Modality strengthened
cases.analysis: A possible trade-off becomes a promised consequence.
cases.nextStep: Compare the scope of modal verbs in addition to surface grammar, and reject unsupported increases in certainty.

observedEvent.originalQuote: An abstention rule may make the limits of the evidence clearer while leaving a less complete map.
observedEvent.revisedQuote: An abstention rule may make the limits of the evidence clearer, but it will leave a less complete map.
observedEvent.problem: Changes a possible tradeoff into a definite prediction that the map will be less complete.
observedEvent.evidenceType: model audit finding with exact supplied quotations; assess its validity before treating it as a confirmed error

cases.title: Valid deletion rejected by the repair schema
cases.analysis: The model proposed removing an unsupported clause, but an empty replacement fails the current nonempty-after constraint.
cases.nextStep: Permit deletion patches when a unique exact anchor, coverage bound and post-edit semantic audit all pass; test this change on separate data.

cases.title: Bias mitigation presented as a guarantee
cases.analysis: Retaining difficult days reduces one selection risk but cannot guarantee accurate reliability estimates.
cases.nextStep: Preserve the qualified relationship between the procedure and the risk it addresses.

observedEvent.originalQuote: We will preserve instances of service disruption, since removing difficult days could make the policy appear more dependable than it is.
observedEvent.revisedQuote: We will retain instances of service disruption to ensure the policy's reliability is accurately reflected.
observedEvent.problem: Retaining disruptions helps avoid an overly favourable assessment but cannot ensure accurate reliability estimates. The revision replaces a qualified bias concern with an unsupported guarantee.
observedEvent.evidenceType: model audit finding with exact supplied quotations; assess its validity before treating it as a confirmed error

cases.title: Grammar worsens during naturalization
cases.analysis: The revision combines two incompatible comparative constructions.
cases.nextStep: Check local grammar independently of lexical simplification; keep the original construction when the change is not an improvement.

observedEvent.originalQuote: may care as much about an unusually long delay as they do about a typical journey
observedEvent.revisedQuote: may care equally about an unusually long delay as they do about a typical journey
observedEvent.problem: “Equally about ... as they do about” is an awkward comparative construction. Retain “as much about ... as” or use “equally about ... and ...”.
observedEvent.evidenceType: model audit finding with exact supplied quotations; assess its validity before treating it as a confirmed error

cases.title: Concrete evaluation safeguard omitted
cases.analysis: A general promise of neutrality replaces the explicit restriction against selecting a favourable threshold definition.
cases.nextStep: Represent fixed methodological safeguards as content commitments, not removable stylistic detail.

observedEvent.originalQuote: Sensitivity checks will vary the definition of a long wait without selecting the definition that most favours either policy.
observedEvent.revisedQuote: Sensitivity checks will vary the definition of a long wait without favouring either policy.
observedEvent.problem: The revision removes the explicit commitment against selecting the most favourable definition. A general promise of neutrality does not preserve this concrete safeguard against selective reporting.
observedEvent.evidenceType: model audit finding with exact supplied quotations; assess its validity before treating it as a confirmed error

cases.title: Temporal scope altered
cases.analysis: A rule fixed before observation is rewritten as a rule maintained only until observation starts.
cases.nextStep: Check temporal connectors as relations, because the same nouns and numbers do not guarantee the same commitment.

observedEvent.originalQuote: These roles will remain fixed before observation begins.
observedEvent.revisedQuote: These roles will be maintained until observations begin
observedEvent.problem: “Until” implies that the commitment to fixed outcome roles ends when observation begins, weakening the prespecified outcome hierarchy.
observedEvent.evidenceType: model audit finding with exact supplied quotations; assess its validity before treating it as a confirmed error

cases.title: Conservative whole-document rejection
cases.analysis: The auditor distinguishes a reporting commitment from a close statement about test limitations; the entire candidate is consequently rejected.
cases.nextStep: Obtain human equivalence labels for borderline cases and calibrate the rejection policy; this observation is a possible over-rejection, not a confirmed false positive.

observedEvent.originalQuote: Tests will check the supplied examples, but passing them will not be presented as proof that a program is correct for every input [S1].
observedEvent.revisedQuote: While tests will verify the supplied examples, passing them does not guarantee the program's correctness for all inputs [S1].
observedEvent.problem: The candidate preserves the limitation of testing but omits the explicit commitment not to present passing tests as proof of correctness for every input.

cases.title: Assessor role changed
cases.analysis: An editorial simplification shifts the stated assessor from an editor to the study authors.
cases.nextStep: Preserve who performs each action, especially when review responsibilities are part of the design.

observedEvent.originalQuote: They will not be counted as unnecessary hedging when an editor assesses whether a revision is more concise.
observedEvent.revisedQuote: We will consider these qualifications as integral content and not count them as unnecessary hedging when assessing conciseness.
observedEvent.problem: The revision removes the explicit role of an editor in assessing conciseness and instead assigns the assessment to the authors. Preserve the specified assessor.
observedEvent.evidenceType: model audit finding with exact supplied quotations; assess its validity before treating it as a confirmed error

cases.title: Controlled comparison overinterpreted
cases.analysis: Holding one factor fixed is rewritten as establishing the sole cause of any observed difference.
cases.nextStep: Separate the factor controlled by the design from the causal conclusion that the evidence would support.

observedEvent.originalQuote: This isolates the effect of correction from a change in alert policy.
observedEvent.revisedQuote: This design ensures that any changes in alert counts are attributable to the correction process rather than alterations in the alert policy.
observedEvent.problem: The revision strengthens a controlled comparison into a blanket causal guarantee. A fixed threshold rules out threshold changes as an explanation but does not establish that any change in alert counts must result from correction.
observedEvent.evidenceType: model audit finding with exact supplied quotations; assess its validity before treating it as a confirmed error

cases.title: Citation scope expanded
cases.analysis: A citation is attached to additional limitations that are not stated in that source packet.
cases.nextStep: Check the proposition supported by each citation occurrence rather than only whether the identifier is allowed.

observedEvent.originalQuote: A reference instrument can itself have error, and the study covers only a limited observation period.
observedEvent.revisedQuote: A reference instrument can itself have errors, and the study covers only a limited observation period [S1].
observedEvent.problem: The added citation attributes reference-instrument error and the limited observation period to S1, which states neither.
observedEvent.evidenceType: model audit finding with exact supplied quotations; assess its validity before treating it as a confirmed error

cases.title: Citation occurrence lost
cases.analysis: A requirement remains in prose but loses its explicit source attribution.
cases.nextStep: Retain section-level citation occurrence checks and expose the rejection reason in the ledger.

observedEvent.originalQuote: Difficult days will remain in the overall result [S2].
observedEvent.revisedQuote: Difficult days will remain in the overall results.
observedEvent.problem: The revision removes the citation to S2, losing explicit attribution for the requirement to include difficult days in the overall results.
observedEvent.evidenceType: model audit finding with exact supplied quotations; assess its validity before treating it as a confirmed error

cases.title: Dangling modifier introduced
cases.analysis: The rewritten clause grammatically assigns calculation to the recovered material rather than to the researchers.
cases.nextStep: Check the actor of a shortened clause; a concise sentence is not automatically a coherent sentence.

observedEvent.problem: The implied subject of 'calculating' is the recovered output, creating an awkward modifier. Retain the passive clause or explicitly identify who calculates the measures.
observedEvent.evidenceType: model audit finding with exact supplied quotations; assess its validity before treating it as a confirmed error

cases.title: Equivalent numeric wording rejected
cases.analysis: Changing 18 to eighteen preserves the quantity but removes a digit token. The lexical gate rejects this valid paraphrase even though the semantic auditor accepts it.
cases.nextStep: Normalize equivalent number expressions before comparing quantities and retain role-sensitive semantic checks for swapped values.

observedEvent.referenceReason: Meaning-preserving paraphrase; numerical wording may change form without changing value.
